about: NUMBER PENDING (train e95): on the runtime lane a name bound to a request that reads ANOTHER series' bars (another symbol, an event read) and read inside a call's arguments (`nz(e, -1)`, `na(e)`) reaches the run's supply instead of the columnar lane's supply-less `na`; a name bound to the chart's own request keeps the columnar lane. Every rule, broken once, must turn its rail red.

mutants.mutant: a name inside a call's arguments is never followed (the defect: the columnar lane's silent na)
a name bound to the chart's OWN request is sent to the run too
a name bound through another name is not followed
